preconditions.description: The number of songs is between 1 and 10^5, and the number of queries is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of the initial song s_0 is between 1 and 100.
The length of the string t is equal to n.
The index of the song k is between 0 and n.

preconditions.expression: All strings consist only of lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: All input strings contain only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: The sum of lengths of sailors' names does not exceed 10^6
preconditions.description: The total length of all sailor names does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output should consist of q lines, each containing the remainder modulo 10^9+7 of the number of occurrences of w in s_k.

invariants.expression: s_i is constructed as described in the problem statement
invariants.description: The sequence of songs s_i is constructed by concatenating s_i with t_i and then s_i again for each i.
